import argparse

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Print "Hello, NAME!" multiple times.')
    parser.add_argument('--name', required=True, help='Name to include in the greeting.')
    parser.add_argument('--times', type=int, default=1, help='Number of times to print the greeting (default: 1).')
    
    args = parser.parse_args()
    
    if not args.name:
        print("Missing --name argument.")
        return 1
    
    if args.times <= 0:
        print("Times must be a positive integer.")
        return 1
    
    for _ in range(args.times):
        print(f"Hello, {args.name}!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
